metadata.question: On June 24, 2025, was New York City highest temperature higher than June 24, 2024?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - Location: NYC bounding box polygon.
   - Primary dataset: GRIDMET daily (IDAHO_EPSCOR/GRIDMET) band 'tmmx' (daily maximum temperature, K) for 2024-06-24 and 2025-06-24.
   - Fallback dataset: ERA5-Land hourly (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) band 'temperature_2m' (K); compute daily max from hourly images.
2. Masking strategy
   - Not cloud-based; these are gridded products. No cloud masking needed. Validate non-null pixel counts.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error
   - If collection size is 0 for a date after fallback attempts → C1.
   - If reduceRegion returns 0 valid pixels → C2.
   - If max temperature is null/NaN or outside [230K, 330K] → C3.
   - Otherwise compare 2025 vs 2024; print A if higher, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getGridmetMax(dateStr, geom) {
  const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
  const end = start.advance(1, 'day');
  const col = ee.ImageCollection('IDAHO_EPSCOR/GRIDMET')
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filterBounds(geom)
    .select('tmmx');
  const size = await col.size().getInfo();
  if (!size || size === 0) {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'empty' };
  }
  const img = ee.Image(col.first());
  const scale = 4000; // ~4km gridMET
  const maxDict = await img.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).getInfo();
  const countDict = await ee.Image(1).updateMask(img.mask()).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).getInfo();
  const k = maxDict ? maxDict['tmmx'] : null;
  const count = countDict ? countDict['constant'] : 0;
  return { ok: true, k: k, count: count || 0, images: size, dataset: 'GRIDMET', scale: scale };
}

async function getERA5Max(dateStr, geom) {
  const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
  const end = start.advance(1, 'day');
  const col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filterBounds(geom)
    .select('temperature_2m');
  const size = await col.size().getInfo();
  if (!size || size === 0) {
    return { ok: false, reason: 'empty' };
  }
  const img = col.max(); // hourly max over the day
  const scale = 9000; // ~9 km ERA5-Land
  const maxDict = await img.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).getInfo();
  const countDict = await ee.Image(1).updateMask(img.mask()).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  }).getInfo();
  const k = maxDict ? maxDict['temperature_2m'] : null;
  const count = countDict ? countDict['constant'] : 0;
  return { ok: true, k: k, count: count || 0, images: size, dataset: 'ERA5-LAND (hourly->daily max)', scale: scale };
}

async function getDailyMax(dateStr, geom) {
  // Try GRIDMET first
  let r = await getGridmetMax(dateStr, geom);
  if (!r.ok) {
    // Fallback to ERA5-LAND hourly
    r = await getERA5Max(dateStr, geom);
  }
  return r;
}

function isBadValueK(k) {
  if (k === null || k === undefined) return true;
  const n = Number(k);
  if (!isFinite(n)) return true;
  // Physical sanity for near-surface temp
  return (n < 230 || n > 330);
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions (NYC bounding box)
    const nyc = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[-74.30, 40.45], [-73.65, 40.45], [-73.65, 40.95], [-74.30, 40.95], [-74.30, 40.45]]],
      null, false
    );
    const areaKm2 = (await nyc.area(1).getInfo()) / 1e6;

    const dateA = '2024-06-24';
    const dateB = '2025-06-24';

    // 2. Acquire and compute daily max for both dates with fallback
    const resA = await getDailyMax(dateA, nyc);
    const resB = await getDailyMax(dateB, nyc);

    // 3. Handle missing collections
    if (!resA.ok || !resB.ok) {
      console.log(`Area km2: ${areaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
      if (!resA.ok) console.log(`${dateA}: No images (all sources)`);
      if (!resB.ok) console.log(`${dateB}: No images (all sources)`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Handle no valid pixels after masking
    if ((resA.count || 0) === 0 || (resB.count || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`Area km2: ${areaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
      console.log(`${dateA}: Dataset=${resA.dataset}, Images=${resA.images || 0}, Pixels=${resA.count || 0}`);
      console.log(`${dateB}: Dataset=${resB.dataset}, Images=${resB.images || 0}, Pixels=${resB.count || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validate values
    if (isBadValueK(resA.k) || isBadValueK(resB.k)) {
      console.log(`Area km2: ${areaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
      console.log(`${dateA}: Dataset=${resA.dataset}, Images=${resA.images}, Pixels=${resA.count}, TmaxK=${resA.k}`);
      console.log(`${dateB}: Dataset=${resB.dataset}, Images=${resB.images}, Pixels=${resB.count}, TmaxK=${resB.k}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 6. Comparison
    const cA = Number(resA.k) - 273.15;
    const cB = Number(resB.k) - 273.15;
    const diff = cB - cA;

    // 7. Evidence prints (<= 20 lines total)
    console.log(`Area km2: ${areaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`${dateA}: Dataset=${resA.dataset}, Images=${resA.images}, Pixels=${resA.count}, TmaxC=${cA.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`${dateB}: Dataset=${resB.dataset}, Images=${resB.images}, Pixels=${resB.count}, TmaxC=${cB.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Difference (2025-2024) C: ${diff.toFixed(2)}`);

    // 8. Final answer
    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Any runtime/syntax/memory issues
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
